body:
```suggestion
			The approach used for 3D scene traversal when physics interpolation is enabled.
			- [code]DEFAULT[/code]: The default optimized method.
			- [code]Legacy[/code]: The previous method used in Godot 4.4 and prior for scene tree traversal, which is slower.
			- [code]Debug[/code]: Same as the default optimized method, but provides logging information (which in turn makes it slower). Intended for debugging only; you should use the [code]DEFAULT[/code] method in most cases.
```

body:
I've updated but with slightly different wording, as the previous method has only been available in 4.x since 4.5 dev 4 (!). I guess we could call it "reference" method instead, but maybe that is a less commonly used word than "legacy" for users.

Additionally `Debug` mode actually swaps between the two methods, in order to check for visual regressions (batching has a similar debug mode).

- [code]DEFAULT[/code]: The default optimized method.
- [code]Legacy[/code]: The previous reference method used for scene tree traversal, which is slower.
- [code]Debug[/code]: Swaps between [code]DEFAULT[/code] and [code]Legacy[/code] methods on alternating frames, and provides logging information (which in turn makes it slower). Intended for debugging only; you should use the [code]DEFAULT[/code] method in most cases.

Let me know if you want any further tweaks. :+1:
